evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence.
findings: 200-Ki Ki Blast Super. Fires a controllable beam that can reach XL range and hit up to 10 times; current skill documentation reports up to 10% total damage across 10 hits. A back-input during the command performs a backflip before firing, and guarding after the backflip cancels the attack. The canonical class is corrected to Super to match the dedicated Super-variant documentation.

canonical_changes.classification_correction: Canonical class corrected from Evasive to Super to match the dedicated Super-variant record.
